title: Global Governance Surface Inventory
objective: Create a complete machine-readable inventory of every repository surface that currently defines, records, implies, mirrors, or modifies governance authority.
reason_for_patch: The Validation Department cannot be designed against an assumed governance structure. Governance must first be located, classified, and checked for conflicting or stale authority.

registration_gate.reason: The inventory may be registered as transitional evidence after provenance and core-rule registration.

inventory_completion_gate.reason: The inventory remains partial because 514 blocking ambiguities are unresolved.

expected_gate_result.reason: The inventory may now be validly registered as transitional evidence, but it remains incomplete because 514 blocking ambiguities are unresolved.

inventory_count_preservation.rule: This patch must reproduce these counts from the registered inventory artifacts or fail closed. It must not manually alter counts to satisfy validation.

rules: Absolute host paths must not participate in logical snapshot identity.
Included and excluded roots must be canonically sorted.
Unrelated dirty changes must not be included in patch modifications.
The snapshot must represent the evidence source, not claim repository cleanliness.

new_live_rule.scope: Governance inventory artifacts and inventory-derived reports only.
new_live_rule.effect: Constrains what inventories may do; does not authorize any inventoried surface.

architectural_constraints: The future target is database authority for all non-code program state.
Current file-based governance must be inventoried before migration or removal.
No governance surface may be treated as authoritative based only on filename, directory, age, or registration.
Existing historical records must not be deleted.
Unrelated working-tree changes must remain untouched.

include: database governance tables or schema definitions
scripts that create or modify governance records

required_preflight.action: Record git status and current commit.
required_preflight.purpose: Distinguish existing changes from patch-authored outputs.
Apply current repository execution constraints without treating them as automatically authoritative governance.

required_preflight.action: Locate existing database schema or tables related to governance.
required_preflight.purpose: Determine whether database governance authority already exists.

stage_2_content_discovery.method: Bounded text search for explicit authority language.

stage_3_surface_classification.method: Classify each candidate using explicit content and references.
stage_3_surface_classification.rule: Do not infer authority from path or naming alone.

stage_4_relationship_extraction.method: Extract references, dependencies, supersession links, hashes, and registry membership.

required_questions: Is it explicitly marked as a proposal?
Does its registry entry imply authority?
Does any current governance authorize its registration?
Does it mix history and live authority?
Can non-authoritative proposals be registered safely?

special_required_checks.objective: Determine whether a governance database or governance tables already exist.
required_questions: What governance state is already stored in the database?
Are file registries mirrors or independent truths?
Can current governance be reconstructed from the database?

special_required_checks.objective: Locate current definitions of staleness, supersession, invalidation, and recurrence.
required_questions: Who may declare an artifact stale?

special_required_checks.objective: Locate current protections for database and governance history.
required_questions: Are backups and restore tests governed?

mini_agent_task_decomposition.rule: Do not ask Codex Mini to inventory and interpret all governance in one prompt.

required_outputs.target: database preferred; transitional JSON allowed only if database ingestion is not yet available
required_outputs.description: Complete inventory of discovered governance-bearing surfaces.

required_outputs.target: database preferred; transitional JSON allowed only if database ingestion is not yet available
required_outputs.description: References, supersession, dependencies, mirrors, and authority relationships.

required_outputs.target: database preferred; transitional JSON allowed only if database ingestion is not yet available
required_outputs.description: Surfaces whose authority or SSOT status cannot be determined.

required_outputs.target: database preferred; transitional JSON allowed only if database ingestion is not yet available
required_outputs.description: Counts and bounded findings derived mechanically from the inventory.

requirements: Record that the fallback files are temporary.
Do not register fallback outputs as live governance.
Do not create duplicate copies in docs and registry.
Do not add a new index merely for discovery.

validation_requirements: Every discovered candidate must receive a surface_id.
Every inventory record must satisfy the inventory schema.
Every authority classification must cite explicit evidence.
No path may appear twice unless distinct logical surfaces are documented.
All required special checks must be completed.
The output must distinguish absence of evidence from evidence of absence.
The inventory must record the dirty working-tree state.
The legacy global validator result must not be used as proof of inventory correctness.
A stale_report_warning result must not be described as a trustworthy validation pass.
completion_criteria: All in-scope governance-bearing paths and database surfaces have been searched.
Every discovered surface has a structured record.
Registry semantics are explicitly classified or marked unknown.
The Validation Department proposal authority status is classified.
Current staleness authority is located or recorded as missing.
Current data-preservation authority is located or recorded as missing.
No governance files or database records were modified except patch-authorized inventory outputs.
No new live authority was created.
stop_conditions: Stop if a required registry cannot be parsed safely.
Stop classification of a surface when authority evidence is ambiguous.
Record AUTHORITY_UNKNOWN rather than infer authority.
Do not repair conflicts during this patch.
Do not activate or register the Validation Department.
Do not migrate governance into the database during this patch.
prohibited_actions: Do not delete or archive governance surfaces.
Do not add the proposal to another registry.
Do not create a new SSOT.
Do not declare a current canonical governance hierarchy.
Do not claim governance is modernized.
Do not claim the Validation Department is ready.
Do not claim repository-wide validation success.

expected_stop_point.statement: Stop after producing the inventory and ambiguity register.
expected_stop_point.next_work_not_included: Do not begin governance gap analysis or modernization until Patch 2 has been reviewed.
